messages:
evan: Quick one  noticed a bunch of fncall traces where `validation` exists but `validation.code` has inconsistent formats across services (e.g. `enum_mismatch` vs `enum-mismatch`). Our log regex only picks up the underscore form so a lot of reasons go unindexed. Also some downstream systems choke on hyphens in metric labels.
priya: oof. paste an example?
evan: two anonymized validator envelopes from recent runs:
```
{"req":"r-7a","validation":{"status":"soft_reject","code":"enum_mismatch","billing_exempt":true}}
{"req":"r-7b","validation":{"status":"soft_reject","code":"enum-mismatch","billing_exempt":true}}
```
hoshi: yep i've seen both. The validator lib historically used snake_case, the proxy canonicalizer used kebab-case for human readability. That mismatch breaks the logging regex and metric label sanitizers.
marco: impact: k/v extraction in logging pipeline misses half the reasons, metrics split into two label values (bad for cardinality), and console tooling shows duplicate human messages which looks like different reasons to customers.
priya: agreed we need two changes: 1) canonicalize `validation.code` at the proxy edge to a safe internal token (e.g. `enum_mismatch`) before emitting audit lines/metrics 2) relax regexes in logging to accept both forms while we remediate.
ehan: (typo) evan: +1. Also metric label values must be sanitised to match prometheus conventions: replace hyphens with underscores and lowercase. We should centralize sanitizer.
hoshi: propose a small shim in proxy: map known legacy codes -> canonical code, and run a sanitizer `s/[^a-z0-9_]/_/g`. Emit audit: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject r-7b reason=enum_mismatch`. For backcompat add original_code as an optional field: `original_reason=enum-mismatch` in the audit line.
marco: console: show human-friendly message but use canonical code for grouping. Also add a tooltip that shows original reason if present. Avoid exposing internal tokens to customers.
priya: metrics: emit `fncall.validation.soft_reject_total{reason="enum_mismatch",route="soft_reject",model="open-7b"}`. Ensure exporter only sees canonical reason.
evan: logging regex suggestion while we migrate: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject (r-[0-9a-z]+) reason=([a-z0-9_-]+)( original_reason=([a-z0-9_-]+))?` That accepts both underscores and hyphens and optional original.
hoshi: tests: unit for sanitizer + mapping table; integration test to assert logging pipeline parses reason and metrics only get canonical label. I'll own that.
marco: deploy plan: land proxy canonicalizer behind a feature flag, run canary for 24h, then flip on globally and relax regex retention window for a week. Console UI behind feature flag too.
priya: small UX note: avoid exposing too many distinct reasons in top-level charts; group low-volume variants under "other". We'll set threshold at 100/day.
\e van: (typo fixed) evan: Action items: hoshi -> shim + tests, marco -> canary + rollout + audit regex update w/logs team, priya -> console grouping + tooltip, infra-bot -> staging deploy.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: initiated staging deploy (id s-4444) for proxy canonicalizer by hoshi 3:12UTC, checks running.
ops-bot: will monitor logging ingestion for missing reasons and alert on >5% unparsed.
ehoshi: landing PR now, tagging @marco @priya. will post canary results in this thread.
priya: thanks all. this should clean up a lot of noisy tickets. :thumbsup:
